INSTALLATION
  1. Extract the archive to any folder
  2. Run PBZ_TrainerSetup.exe
  3. Choose an install folder and click Install
  4. Right-click PhantomBladeZero_Trainer.exe → Run as administrator
  5. Launch Phantom Blade Zero
  6. Press [INSERT] in-game to open the trainer menu

If the trainer doesn't appear — make sure you run as administrator and the game is in windowed or borderless mode.
